description: This file defines the FormPreprocess class with methods for preprocessing various form elements and templates in Drupal, including form, form elements, labels, input, textarea, select, fieldset, details, radios, checkboxes, and vertical tabs.

classes.name: FormPreprocess
classes.description: Contains methods for preprocessing form elements and templates in Drupal.

methods.name: preprocessForm
methods.description: Prepares variables for form templates, setting attributes and children.

methods.name: preprocessFormElement
methods.description: Prepares variables for individual form element templates, handling labels, attributes, and descriptions.

methods.name: preprocessFormElementLabel
methods.description: Prepares variables for form label templates, setting label attributes and required markers.

methods.name: preprocessInput
methods.description: Prepares variables for input element templates, removing empty name attributes.

methods.name: preprocessTextarea
methods.description: Prepares variables for textarea templates, setting attributes and resizable classes.

methods.name: preprocessSelect
methods.description: Prepares variables for select element templates, setting options and attributes.

methods.name: preprocessFieldset
methods.description: Prepares variables for fieldset templates, handling attributes, legends, and descriptions.

methods.name: preprocessDetails
methods.description: Prepares variables for details element templates, managing attributes, summaries, and accessibility.

methods.name: preprocessRadios
methods.description: Prepares variables for radios templates, setting attributes and children.

methods.name: preprocessCheckboxes
methods.description: Prepares variables for checkboxes templates, setting attributes and children.

methods.name: preprocessVerticalTabs
methods.description: Prepares variables for vertical tabs templates, handling children.
